quests.title: Mountain Mixologist

dialogue.t: No, no, that's too little! Even if the total number of the order is higher, the unit price per case shouldn't be this low.
Well, that's not a bad offer, but considering the difficulty of transportation to Qingce Village, it's still a tough one.
Deal! You two are fast learners. The second time we did business, we ended up in a win-win situation for everyone!
Yup, you guys drive a hard bargain!
Ah, I guess I've been underestimated! Let's agree on the price I asked for this time. Think of it as your fee for negotiation skills.
Are you guys from out of town? Welcome to Qingce Village!
Paimon first! Paimon first! Let's introduce ourselves first!
This is the almighty Traveler, {NICKNAME}, and Paimon is this Traveler's best companion, Paimon.
We are ordering specialty drinks from the Weinlesefest for out-of-town clients. We saw your commission, so we decided to come talk to you.
Ah, I like how direct you are! Then I'll cut to the chase, too.
I'm Chef Guanchui, and I need <color=#00E1FFFF>100 cases of "Fruits of the Festival,"</color> to make tea to help keep the spirits up for the guys doing manual labor.
Okay! Before we get to work, please give us the funds.
One step ahead of you. Please take these Fairbrew Jellies! After ordering, there will probably be some left over. Doesn't matter how much is left, please keep the change as reward for your hard work!
We'll take it and be on our way!
Right on! I await the good news from both of you!
What are you standing there for, {NICKNAME}? Let's go!
If you have anything to talk about, we'll talk after you place the order.
The sooner we finish the job, the sooner we can open our shop!
Opening a shop, mmhmm...
Oh! You're back?
Are you still helping to place orders for foreign clients?
Yup. This time we need 100 cases of "Fruits of the Festival," for Guanchui, the chef of Qingce Village.
We're ready to make an offer, Georg!

dialogue.sit: Why do I get the feeling of business rivalry...
Get ready to be surprised, Georg!

dialogue.t: Oh! The ball's rolling! Let me see what you've got this time!
I can't think of a better specialty drink for this Weinlesefest than the tea brewed with the spring water from Qingce Village.
Thank you, both of you!

dialogue.sit: Could you tell me more about yourself?

dialogue.t: It hasn't been that long since I moved back to the farm with my brothers. Usually I am in charge of cooking for the boys who work in the field.
But most of what I do is just simple and filling dishes, which are not quite suitable for out-of-town guests.
Qingce Village is pretty quiet, but there is no shortage of good food. You can tell by just simply walking around!
Okay, just like last time, the documents will be given to you, and I will arrange the transportation.
Since he is a new customer, you'd better give him the receipt, so as to make him feel at ease.
You have a point. We thought so too!
Let's go, {NICKNAME}. Let's head back to Qingce Village and report back.
Guanchui, we're back!
We've placed an order for your 100 cases of "Fruits of the Festival." Here's your receipt.
Amazing! You two have been a big help!
I will study the "Fruits of the Festival" carefully and mix the fresh drink with the tea with a specific proportion. I'll bring out the flavor, so that the workers will be able to work harder!
Eh, sounds a bit like bartending, but with tea... Is that even possible?
Don't worry, I used to be a chef when I was abroad for a while. This approach achieves the best balance between cost and taste, and I've made it many times!

dialogue.sit: Makes me want to try it...

dialogue.t: The next time you guys come to Qingce Village, I'll treat you guys to the finished product.
Okay! Next time {NICKNAME} can try it!
Thank you! Come back when you've got time!

quests.description: Chef Guanchui, who has just recently returned to Qingce Village, seems to be worried about his friend’s thirst-quenching drinks…
